messages.subject: Limits to Shiny Server
parts:
So, I've been deploying my Shiny-app now, and it has a file upload possibility (you can upload a zip file with multiple data-files).

What are the file limits to an instance? How much disk space can I use up? I wouldn't want to get to that limit, but I can't really access the file system.

Kind regards,

Mats

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Limits to Shiny Server
parts: There is currently no limit on the amount of disk space that can be used. However, this is likely to change. We will enforce some type of limit in the coming months. However please keep in mind that data written to application instances is not persisted, or durable in any way.
